events.continuity_hook: The room occupancy is corrected; the final open item is written confirmation of the second massage time before the cancellation window closes.
events.interaction_goal: Check the resort's revised confirmation, isolate the remaining spa discrepancy, and prepare a concise follow-up requesting a firm treatment time.
events.scenario_brief: The resort has added Priya's spouse to the Sonoma room, but its reply confirms only one massage time and leaves the second treatment listed at the original simultaneous start. The free-cancellation deadline is three days away, so Priya needs to determine whether the staggered schedule can still be honored before keeping the booking.

events.continuity_hook: The outbound can be narrowed now, while the Friday return depends on the host's transportation plan and the realistic airport transfer time.
events.interaction_goal: Build a practical round-trip shortlist that meets the Wednesday arrival requirement and identifies Friday departures compatible with both transfer possibilities.
events.scenario_brief: Priya has been assigned a three-day supplier audit in Bothell beginning Wednesday, July 10, with an 8:30 a.m. site arrival. She will fly from San Francisco and is weighing Tuesday arrivals; the closing session is expected to end Friday at 3:00 p.m., but the host has not yet confirmed whether transportation back to Seattle-Tacoma airport will be arranged.

events.continuity_hook: Both schedule changes are known; the flight choice can be completed after comparing elapsed travel time and the usable buffer around the briefing and airport transfer.
events.interaction_goal: Revise the outbound and return shortlist against the confirmed briefing and ground-transfer schedule, then identify the most workable itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The Bothell host has added a mandatory auditor briefing at 5:30 p.m. Tuesday and confirmed a shared car to the airport after Friday's 3:00 p.m. close. Priya now needs an earlier outbound than the initial shortlist and must reassess whether the proposed Friday flights leave enough margin for traffic and check-in.

events.continuity_hook: Air travel is settled, and lodging remains the final item needed for trip approval and a reliable first-morning arrival.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the compliant hotels using realistic morning travel times, arrival logistics, breakfast hours, and business-receipt availability, then select the stronger option.
events.scenario_brief: With the Seattle-area flights selected, Priya needs three nights near the Bothell supplier site. Two properties fit the authorized lodging amount, but one has an uncertain early-breakfast schedule and the other is farther from the facility during morning traffic; both need to be checked for late Tuesday arrival and an itemized folio.

events.continuity_hook: The trip remains booked as originally arranged; the decision is whether the earlier finish creates enough practical and financial benefit to modify both reservations.
events.interaction_goal: Evaluate the earlier return alternatives and associated fare difference, then determine whether the flight and hotel reservations should be changed together.
events.scenario_brief: The selected Bothell hotel and flights are booked, but the supplier has moved Friday's closing session to a remote meeting ending at noon. Priya can now leave for the airport much earlier, and she wants to compare the cost and timing of changing the return flight while checking whether shortening the hotel stay would alter the total or incur a penalty.

events.continuity_hook: Conference attendance is expected, but the workshop decision must be made before flights and lodging dates can be finalized.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two trip shapes and produce a clear flight-and-hotel cost outline that supports a decision on the Sunday workshop.
events.scenario_brief: Priya plans to attend a quality-systems conference in Chicago from Monday, August 19 through Wednesday, August 21. An optional Sunday afternoon workshop is relevant to her current projects, so she needs to compare a Sunday arrival with a Monday-morning arrival from San Francisco and assess how the extra night, workshop registration timing, and conference-hotel availability affect the trip.
